0022600110.text: Both teams are 0-1 after one game, with Denver (10th in the West) hosting New Orleans (9th in the West) at home. Denver is without Cameron Johnson (ankle sprain), Julian Strawther (knee sprain), and Spencer Jones (hamstring), and Alpha Diallo is day-to-day with a wrist injury and a game-time decision. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and the Nuggets won the 2025-26 season series 3-0, most recently a 122-116 road win in New Orleans on January 13, 2026.
